note: Belimumab is a monoclonal antibody administered via intravenous infusion or subcutaneous injection. It is NOT available as an oral pill/tablet formulation in the United States.

availability_note: Belimumab is NOT available as oral tablets or capsules. The requested pill variant data cannot be provided as this drug has no pill formulation.
